provenance: Each observation is explicitly classified as PURE_XNA_DERIVED metadata or RUBY_MAPPING_QUALIFICATION; never CNA output
derivation: Foundation 46 Dictionary`2 and LaunchParameters. The BCL half is read out of the admitted Microsoft .NET Framework 4.0 mscorlib. Dictionary`2 is `.class public auto ansi serializable beforefieldinit`, extends System.Object and implements IDictionary<K,V>, ICollection<KeyValuePair<K,V>>, IEnumerable<KeyValuePair<K,V>>, IDictionary, ICollection, IEnumerable, ISerializable and IDeserializationCallback. Its accessibility census settles what a projection owes: six public constructors, one `family` constructor taking SerializationInfo and StreamingContext, twenty-two `private ... newslot virtual final` explicit interface implementations that project to no member at all, and the ordinary public surface get_Comparer, get_Count, get_Keys, get_Values, get_Item, set_Item, Add, Clear, ContainsKey, ContainsValue, GetEnumerator, GetObjectData, OnDeserialization, Remove and TryGetValue. Add is Insert(key, value, add: true) and set_Item is Insert(key, value, add: false); Insert opens with ThrowHelper::ThrowArgumentNullException(ExceptionArgument.key), and finding the key already present throws ArgumentException when add is true and replaces the value and increments version when it is false. get_Item calls FindEntry and ThrowHelper::ThrowKeyNotFoundException() when it answers a negative index. Remove throws on a null key, returns false without touching version when the key is absent, and increments version when an entry goes. Clear returns at its first branch -- `ldfld count; ldc.i4.0; ble.s` straight to `ret` -- so clearing an empty dictionary does not increment version. ContainsValue has a separate null branch answering true for the first null value without consulting a comparer. KeyCollection and ValueCollection each declare exactly four public members -- .ctor(Dictionary<K,V>), get_Count, CopyTo(T[], int32) and GetEnumerator() -- every other member each declares being an explicit interface implementation, including all the mutating ones. The XNA half is read out of the pinned Microsoft.Xna.Framework.Game.dll: LaunchParameters is `.class public auto ansi beforefieldinit` extending Dictionary`2<string,string>, declaring one public parameterless constructor whose body is `base..ctor()` then ParseCommandLineArguments(Environment.GetCommandLineArgs()). ParseCommandLineArguments is `assembly` and ParseKeyValuePair is `private`, so neither is an identity: the trim set is { '/', '-' }, the loop starts at index 1 because element 0 is the executable path, the separator is the FIRST ':' found by String.IndexOf(char), an argument with no colon keeps the whole argument as the key and String.Empty as the value, and the write is guarded by `!ContainsKey(key) && key != String.Empty` over `Add`, so the first occurrence of a name wins and an empty key is skipped. Game::get_LaunchParameters is one ldfld; the field is written in exactly one place, Game..ctor, and nothing in the assembly reads it again.
